item.title: Delaware House & Senate pass “Mini” Bond Bill
item.description: DOVER, Del. – The Delaware Senate unanimously passed House Bill 270 Thursday, also known as the “Mini” Bond Bill. The bill makes adjustments to the allocation of existing appropriations within the $977 million capital budget for Fiscal Year 26.
